messages:
liz_support: FYI a customer hit a rerank error after copying the Console cURL example. They pasted it into their CI and got a 422. Full context below.

liz_support: Customer says they followed the example under /docs/api/rerank -> 'Console example' and used the exact curl. On macOS it worked, but in their CI (Ubuntu image) the payload was mangled. Error: 'invalid input: scores must be array of numbers'

liz_support: Here is the exact curl they pasted into CI (redacted):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "query": "best laptop battery life",
    "candidates": ["Model A","Model B"],
    "scores": [0.9, 0.8]
  }'
```

liz_support: Response from API (customer pasted):

```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request",
    "message": "Invalid field 'scores': expected array of numbers, got string",
    "status": 422
  }
}
```

omar_engineer: hmm. first suspicion: CI shell is interpreting the single quotes and the backslash-newline escaping from their copy-paste. windows/cmd vs bash differences often cause the payload to be a single string or include literal CRLFs. can you ask for the raw request body from their logs?

liz_support: asked for raw_body. they pasted this snippet from their CI job log: `-d '{\n    "query": "best laptop battery life",\n    "candidates": ["Model A","Model B"],\n    "scores": [0.9, 0.8]\n  }'` but when we printed it on the server it looked like: `{"query":"best laptop battery life","candidates":"[\"Model A\",\"Model B\"]","scores":"[0.9, 0.8]"}` so arrays got turned into strings.

omar_engineer: yep that's the classic copy-from-console -> CI issue. Our console example uses literal newlines and backslash-newline to format curl, which some shells (or the CI YAML parser) concatenates into a single-quoted string, causing JSON to be passed as a shell-escaped single string. try using --data-binary or a @file approach. Example that always works: 

```bash
# create payload.json with proper JSON (no extra escaping)
cat > payload.json <<'JSON'
{
  "query": "best laptop battery life",
  "candidates": ["Model A", "Model B"],
  "scores": [0.9, 0.8]
}
JSON

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @payload.json
```

omar_engineer: or if you must inline, use double quotes for the outer string and escape inner quotes for CI shells that don't like single quotes: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"query\":\"best laptop battery life\",\"candidates\":[\"Model A\",\"Model B\"],\"scores\":[0.9,0.8]}"
```

sarah_docs: thanks for flagging — I reviewed the Console cURL snippet. When we formatted it with backslash-newline to be readable, we didn't include a note about CI YAML and Windows cmd differences. Also one example used single quotes and another used double quotes in a nearby page — inconsistent. I'm going to update docs to: 1) show file-based payload example (recommended), 2) show an inline --data-binary double-quoted variant, and 3) add a small callout about CI/YAML quoting.

sarah_docs: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (deets in PR). Will also add a regression test to console examples.

deploybot: docs repo: deploy of branch docs/curl-escape-fix succeeded: deploy id d-2024-11-12-09.23.

omar_engineer: small follow-up — the customer's payload showed arrays serialized as strings, which will cause rerank to attempt parsing and return 422. We could improve server-side validation error message to explicitly call out 'did you pass JSON arrays as strings (common with copy-paste from console examples)?' Should I file a tiny infra ticket to improve that error?

liz_support: yes please, that would reduce noise. filing internal ticket and looping QA. I'll let the customer know the workaround (use payload file or escaped inline). Thanks! :thumbsup:

omar_engineer: noted, ticket INF-2897 created for clearer validation error + docs link.

liz_support: closing here after follow-up with customer. marking resolved once they confirm.
